summary.headline: Astrological Omens and Pythagorean Tables
summary.text: Astrological and divinatory entries on Saturn, bodily parts governed by the stars, games, memoranda, sowing, and tree planting, followed by Pythagorean calculations, Plinthides or cabalistic tables, thunder and earthquake omens, lunar elections, cures, amulets, journeys, adversaries, erotic signs, lunar condition, decans, solid signs, death, planetary joy, and rain. Authorities and works include Pythagoras, David the prophet, Hermes Trismegistus, Orpheus, and Apomasar.
